description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs a real-time speech processing pipeline involving audio input/output, language model interaction, and event handling for a WebRTC call scenario.

classes.name: DailyTransport
classes.description: Handles transport functions for the daily scenario, including input and output methods.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model interactions, maintaining conversation state.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates multiple LLMS and context for managing conversation turns.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline that sequences various components like input, LLM, TTS, etc.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for pipeline execution, such as metrics.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main coroutine that initializes the session, sets up the pipeline, and runs it.

methods.name: on_first_participant_joined(transport, participant)
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the first participant joins, initiating transcription capture and a welcome message.

methods.name: on_participant_left(transport, participant, reason)
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a participant leaves, canceling the ongoing pipeline task.
